title: Reserve the Beach Haven Cottage | Rosemary Beach Rental Cottage – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Beach Haven Cottage is a stunning 2 bed, 3 bath rental with a breathtaking view. Enjoy a stylish stay in the coast when you rent this Rosemary Beach rental cottage today!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Tucked behind the beautiful dunes...

Beach Haven Cottage embodies all that is good about the quintessential beach cottage - expansive Gulf views accentuated by simply fabulous furnishings and an open loft. At the southernmost end is the comfortably classic master bedroom, perfectly paired with an open porch spanning the length of the home. Relax with a glass of wine, a book or a nap with the inviting coastal breezes. Also located on the first floor is a guest room with a queen bed and private bath.

Journey upstairs for jaw-dropping views of the Gulf. Prepare meals in the kitchen with chef-grade appliances. Guests can also enjoy the open loft up a ship's ladder just above the living room and kitchen.

Garage parking for one vehicle. Shared with carriage house.

Need more space? Rent the Beach Haven Carriage House for 25% off (must be rented the same nights as the cottage for the discount to apply).

DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER THIS PROPERTY RENTS 7 NIGHTS FROM SATURDAY - SATURDAY
